note: Grounded fixture for the APP's batch pricing path (apps/app/app/panel/Panel.js).
Cards are from the 2026-08-25 Neo-era Japanese batch run, CSV exported by the app.
PROVENANCE MATTERS HERE. Every comp below carries an `src` field:
'screenshot' — title, price, postage, sold date and location read verbatim off the
batch results panel for that card. These are real SoldComps rows.
'backsolved' — a row the screenshot did not scroll far enough to show, whose total
and date are solved from the published recency-weighted figure in the
CSV so the fixture reproduces that figure exactly. The TITLE is
written to the observed template and is NOT evidence about wording.
`observed` restates what the app itself reported for that card in the CSV/panel, so a
harness can compare its own arithmetic against the shipped run rather than against my
reading of it. `observed.fetched` is the true page size; the comps below are only the
rows we can see, so nothing here may be read as 'this was the whole pool'.
